newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-New South Wales defeat Victoria by 58 runs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-New South Wales defeat Victoria by 58 runs.

text.p: New South Wales defeated Victoria by 58 runs in the final session of their Sheffield Shield match at the Sydney Cricket Ground on Monday.
Victoria were dismissed for 398 after being 100 for five overnight.
Opener Matthew Elliott and wicketkeeper Darren Berry put Victoria within sight of an improbable win with a partnership of 290 runs as Victoria reached 349 for five at tea.
New South Wales hit back shortly after the interval through spinners David Freedman and Stuart MacGill. Freedman took three wickets and MacGill two.
Elliott made 187 and Berry 148, his highest first-class score for Victoria.
New South Wales had set Victoria a winning target of 457.
